text: mk_similarity_graph() expands outward seed artist, breadth-first, calling mk_similar_artists() hop – seed-artist/hop model MusicMatchup app uses. title: Getting Started with musickitr
text: Every node already carries resolved image_url (Apple’s artwork template, real pixel dimensions substituted ), drops straight visNetwork graph circularImage node icons:
code: library(visNetwork)  nodes <- graph$nodes nodes$label <- nodes$name nodes$shape <- "circularImage" nodes$image <- nodes$image_url nodes$size <- ifelse(nodes$hop == 0, 40, 25)  edges <- graph$edges edges$width <- edges$similarity * 3  network <- visNetwork(nodes, edges) |>   visEdges(color = list(color = "#8899aa", opacity = 0.6)) |>   visPhysics(stabilization = TRUE) |>   visEvents(stabilizationIterationsDone = "function () { this.fit(); }")  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(network, "getting-started-network.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

title: Getting Started with musickitr
text: Try different seed artist, increase hops/limit_per_artist mk_similarity_graph() – watch quickly graph grows. Aggregate genres across graph’s nodes “taste fingerprint” whole constellation. See ?mk_get calling Apple Music API endpoint musickitr doesn’t dedicated wrapper yet.

what: Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
title: Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
text: Tidy, tibble-based access Apple Music Catalog API — search, charts, similarity utilities building recommendation/matchup tools, spirit spotifyr. Everything runs native R (auth included — JWT signing uses openssl, external binaries toolchains required).

title: Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
text: Apple Music access requires active Apple Developer Program membership. musickitr never stores, transmits, logs credentials anywhere directly Apple. developer.apple.com → Certificates, IDs & Profiles → Keys, create key MusicKit enabled download .p8 file (one-time download — save somewhere durable). Find Team ID Account → Membership. Note Key ID shown key’s page. Set following environment variables (e.g. .Renviron launching R):
code: MUSICKIT_TEAM_ID=YOUR_TEAM_ID MUSICKIT_KEY_ID=YOUR_KEY_ID MUSICKIT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=~/path/to/AuthKey_YOUR_KEY_ID.p8 MUSICKIT_STOREFRONT=us # Optional, only needed for /v1/me/* endpoints: # MUSICKIT_USER_TOKEN=

title: Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
code: library(musickitr)  # Search the catalog -- returns a named list of tibbles, one per type mk_search("Bad Suns", types = c("artists", "albums"))  # Charts include a `rank` column -- the closest thing Apple's API offers # to a popularity signal (there's no numeric popularity score on artists # or songs, unlike Spotify) charts <- mk_charts(types = "songs", limit = 50)  # Jaccard similarity between two genre sets mk_jaccard(c("Alternative", "Rock"), c("Rock", "Indie Rock"))  # Pairwise similarity matrix across a whole result set -- e.g. as edge # weights for a network/graph visualization mk_jaccard_matrix(charts$songs, id_col = "name", set_col = "genres")  # Anything not wrapped yet: call the API directly and get raw parsed JSON mk_get("/v1/catalog/us/genres")

title: Tidy Access to the Apple Music API
text: Early scaffold — mk_search(), mk_charts(), mk_get(), Jaccard utilities working tested live API. Contributions (additional endpoint wrappers, visualization helpers, etc.) welcome.

what: Convert a DER-encoded ECDSA signature to fixed-length raw r||s — der_ecdsa_to_raw
title: Convert a DER-encoded ECDSA signature to fixed-length raw r||s — der_ecdsa_to_raw
text: JOSE/JWT (RFC 7518) ES256 signatures raw concatenation r s integers, left-padded curve's coordinate length (32 bytes P-256). OpenSSL, contrast, emits ECDSA signatures DER SEQUENCE { INTEGER r, INTEGER s }. unwraps ASN.1 structure repacks fixed-length form API expects.

Convert a DER-encoded ECDSA signature to fixed-length raw r||s — der_ecdsa_to_raw
text: der Raw vector containing DER-encoded ECDSA signature. coord_len Byte length coordinate (32 P-256/ES256).

what: Play a song's preview clip, with a confirmation prompt — mk_play_preview
title: Play a song's preview clip, with a confirmation prompt — mk_play_preview
text: Neither R RStudio anything resembling native audio engine – base R decode play audio . Apple Music previews .m4a (AAC) files, rules audio-adjacent CRAN packages clean fit (tuneR/audio handle WAV; av can decode AAC play back). practical fix shelling afplay, command-line player already built macOS, handles .m4a natively. afplay given URL directly unreliable, though – Apple's CDN redirects trip – downloads preview temporary file first (via httr2, already dependency) plays instead, deleting afterward. macOS-construction; cross-platform fallback (yet).

what: Recommend songs based on a listener's taste profile — mk_recommend_songs
title: Recommend songs based on a listener's taste profile — mk_recommend_songs
text: pipeline stitches together, end end: take listener's -played artists mk_taste_profile(), resolve catalog ID via mk_search() (library/history endpoints return artist names, catalog IDs, unless separately request artists relationship), expand one hop outward mk_similar_artists() – seed/hop mental model mk_similarity_graph() uses – score every candidate artist surfaced way genre overlap profile via mk_jaccard(). Candidates surfaced one seed artist (graph's "convergence points") get small bonus, theory artist library reaches multiple directions stronger signal one reached single artist. top-scoring candidate artists' top songs (mk_artist_top_songs()) final recommendations.

title: Recommend songs based on a listener's taste profile — mk_recommend_songs
code: mk_recommend_songs(   profile = NULL,   n_seed_artists = 5,   n_similar_per_artist = 5,   n_top_genres = 15,   n_candidate_artists = 10,   n_songs_per_artist = 5,   storefront = NULL,   delay = 0.1,   creds = mk_credentials() )

title: Recommend songs based on a listener's taste profile — mk_recommend_songs
text: profile taste profile mk_taste_profile(). Built fresh omitted. n_seed_artists many profile's top artists expand outward . n_similar_per_artist Max similar artists pull per seed (Apple returns 10). n_top_genres many profile's top genres score candidates (keeps scoring focused listener's actual center gravity rather long-tail one-genres). n_candidate_artists many top-scoring candidate artists pull songs . n_songs_per_artist Max songs pull per candidate artist. storefront Storefront code, e.g. "us". Defaults creds$storefront. delay Seconds pause API calls (see mk_similarity_graph()). creds credentials list mk_credentials(), including user_token (needed mk_taste_profile() profile supplied).

what: Build a similarity graph by expanding outward from a seed artist — mk_similarity_graph
title: Build a similarity graph by expanding outward from a seed artist — mk_similarity_graph
text: Repeatedly calls mk_similar_artists() breadth-first seed_id, "seed artist / hop" mental model MusicMatchup app uses. Growing one hand tends get crowded fast – artist returns 10 similar artists, unbounded 2-hop expansion can explode 100+ nodes accounting overlap – caps branching factor per artist (limit_per_artist) total graph size (max_nodes) default, favoring graph can actually look complete one.

title: Build a similarity graph by expanding outward from a seed artist — mk_similarity_graph
code: mk_similarity_graph(   seed_id,   hops = 2,   limit_per_artist = 5,   max_nodes = 150,   delay = 0.1,   storefront = NULL,   image_width = 300,   image_height = 300,   creds = mk_credentials() )

title: Build a similarity graph by expanding outward from a seed artist — mk_similarity_graph
text: seed_id Catalog ID artist start . hops Number hops expand outward. Defaults 2. limit_per_artist Max similar artists keep per node (Apple returns 10). Defaults 5 keep branching manageable. max_nodes Hard cap total nodes graph, including seed. Expansion stops reached, even mid-hop. delay Seconds pause API calls, stay polite rate limit larger graphs. Defaults 0.1. storefront Storefront code, e.g. "us". Defaults creds$storefront. image_width, image_height Pixel dimensions resolve node's artwork template (see image_url return value). Defaults 300x300. creds credentials list mk_credentials().
